title: Frontend Engineer

Designed and implemented distinct workflows for four unique user types, ensuring personalized and efficient user experiences. Implemented a flexible authentication and role-based access control system using Next.js middleware, complete with activity tracking for better security and user management.
summary: As the sole frontend engineer, I built two versions of Helpa's user and admin platforms, including donations in several currencies.
